slides.title: Listening isn't *waiting for your turn* to talk.
slides.sub: Real listening asks more of us than that.

slides.title: Set the reply aside
slides.body: Let go of the answer forming in your mind and give your full attention to what's being said.

slides.title: Hear what isn't said
slides.body: Hesitation. Silence. Context. The meaning beneath the words.

slides.title: Quiet isn't weakness
slides.body: It's discipline. It takes confidence to admit someone else may know something you don't.

slides.title: Not every moment needs your answer
slides.body: It takes patience to resist interrupting. And in that pause, a new habit can begin.

slides.title: Try it once today: give someone your full attention.
